Also serves as the outer-room drafting cave; the Outer Room drafting cave IS West Path's south section, not a separate node.
5th Upgrade Disk reader terminal; no room record in rooms.json

Modelled because it is the only approach to Apple Orchard, and holds the Conservatory's hidden dig spot: arriving here with a held shovel permanently sets conservatory_floorplan_found (special_items.py::on_area_arrival), which decks.py::eligible_pool reads to add the Conservatory to the draft pool from the following day.

nodes.name: Apple Orchard (+20 steps/day - torch on ENTRY)

meta.notes: orchard_unlocked grants +20 starting steps from the following day (GameState.orchard_unlocked, carried like west_gate_unlatched). The torch-on-ENTRY requirement in this node's name is NOT modelled.

nodes.name: Gemstone Cavern (2 gems/day - torch on ENTRY)

meta.notes: Modelled to entrance only; igniting torches grants Tunnel floorplan. Everything deeper is story, not progression.
Upgrade Disk sits openly on a table; obtainable WITHOUT lighting candlesticks. Candles independently open the Precipice stairway.

Reached only via the boiler_room_steam gate from Underpass (Rotating Gear (upstairs), NOT connected to rotating_gear). Grants a gem and the Treasure Trove blackprint on arrival, special_items.py::on_area_arrival.

Each of the 8 realm doors (Arch Aries, Corarica, Eraja, Fenn Aries, Mora Jai, Nuance, Orinda Aries, Verra) is opened independently by 1 Sanctum Key (consumed) via Game.open_sigil_door(realm); stays permanently open (GameConfig.sigil_doors_open). Modelled as one node with per-door state rather than 8 travel-actionable nodes: the assumed-solved +2 allowance from each chamber's Mora Jai box is granted at the moment the door opens (special_items.py::open_sigil_door), so there is nothing left worth walking here for -- stays modelled=false per the 2026-08-04 'holds something worth walking to' rule.

gates.detail: Garage door opens when the breaker is on: the Utility Closet has been placed on the grid AND the player has entered it at least once today. The engine sets the 'garage_door_breaker' flag in GateContext when both conditions hold.
The west gate can only be unlatched from the inside (first ever West Path visit must come via Garage). Once unlatched the flag is permanent.

West Path -> outer room anchor: the destination node id must equal GateContext.outer_room_id (the room drawn as today's outer room). gate_open receives the edge's to_id as dest and compares it to ctx.outer_room_id.

Private Drive -> Blackbridge Grotto: a Laboratory has been powered at least once, on this or any prior day. The POWER conjunct of the owner's two-part Grotto rule; the other conjunct, having entered the Laboratory, is the separate 'lab_visited' gate on the same edge. Owner ruling: 'The house isn't powered. A room is powered. A room is powered if it shares a doorway with another powered room.' engine/power.py computes that connectivity over the door graph, seeded at the rooms registering Capability.POWER_SOURCE (the Boiler Room and the Electric Eel Aquarium); effects/rooms/laboratory.py's ON_DRAFT_ROOM hook records the first moment a placed Laboratory is powered on state.lab_powered, and game.py::_gate_ctx sets this flag from that OR the carried-over cfg.lab_powered (shops.py::carryover). SAVE-scoped exactly like lab_visited -- carried on the named DayChain.lab_powered attribute, left out of _CARRYOVER_KEYS -- because the owner ruled the Grotto unlock is one-time for the entire save. docs/power.md owns the mechanic.

Private Drive -> Blackbridge Grotto: the Laboratory has been entered at least once, on this or any prior day. Owner ruling: 'You only need to unlock the Blackbridge Grotto once for the entire save. However, you need to power and enter the Laboratory for that to happen.' A one-time unlock, so this is a flag gate rather than a kind=room gate (kind=room checks GateContext.rooms_entered, which is rebuilt every day, and is what tomb_catacombs wants). The engine sets this flag in game.py::_gate_ctx from state.lab_visited (set on Laboratory entry, effects/rooms/laboratory.py) OR the carried-over cfg.lab_visited (shops.py::carryover). SAVE-scoped: carried on the named DayChain.lab_visited attribute and left out of the attempt wrap, NOT in _CARRYOVER_KEYS, which the wrap clears -- so unlike boiler_room_steam it survives into the next attempt (docs/scoping-and-carryover.md). The edge's other conjunct, POWER, is the separate 'lab_steam_and_power' gate on the same edge.

Blackbridge Grotto -> Orindian Ruins: three microchips in the pedestal. The Grotto's own chip starts there, so two held chips suffice while it remains; once it has been taken, all three must be held until it respawns the next day.

meta.notes: Owner ruling, from play, 2026-08-12: the third microchip already sits in the Blackbridge Grotto's own pedestal; the player only ever brings the other two in inventory. The gate is satisfiable by two held chips plus the in-place Grotto chip (counts_flag), not by holding three. It respawns the next day if taken and not held to make three.

gates.detail: Campsite -> Apple Orchard: padlock code 1128. Under the sim's 'player solves every puzzle they enter' doctrine this always passes.
Campsite -> Gemstone Cavern: V.A.C. puzzle (Utility Closet) + lever. Under the sim's 'player solves every puzzle' doctrine this always passes.

Grounds <-> Sealed Entrance <-> Basement: the Power Hammer breaks the barrier once and the route stays open for the rest of the attempt; all three edges (grounds->sealed_entrance, sealed_entrance->basement, basement->sealed_entrance) share this one gate. The wiki distinguishes plank-vs-wall permanence (breaking only the Basement wall regrows overnight; breaking the planks does not) -- the owner's ruling, recorded in docs/areas.md's "Sealed Entrance permanence" (2026-08-04), is that any break here is unconditionally permanent, so that distinction is deliberately NOT modelled. Satisfied either by having already broken through (the sealed_entrance_broken flag, set on first arrival at sealed_entrance and carried across days) or by currently holding a Power Hammer.

Grounds -> Well: Fountain water level <= 8, re-checked on every traversal against the current (permanent) level -- not latched, since the level can move both ways within a day as the panel is operated. The engine sets the 'pump_water_lte8' flag in GateContext when Game.water_level('fountain') <= 8.
Grounds -> Crate Tunnel: ignition tool lights the torches, granting the Tunnel floorplan. Requires an ignition tool item (torch or burning_glass).
Grounds -> Precipice: cliffside elevator; requires 4 torches lit AND car at the top. Deferred: torch tracking and elevator position not modelled. Passes (stub open).
Precipice -> Grounds: elevator; only if the car was ridden down (cannot be called up from below). Deferred: elevator position not modelled. Passes (stub open).
The Foundation -> Basement: elevator; crank revealed AND car at the top. Deferred: Foundation elevator position not modelled. Passes (stub open).

The Basement door at the foot of the Foundation's elevator, gating BOTH directions: the wiki unlocks it 'from either side using a Basement Key', so arriving in the Basement by another route does not let you through it. Only a Basement Key opens it (permanently); Lock Pick Kit does not work. Separate lock from the well's door and the unmodelled Crate Tunnel one. Owner ruling: being at a node in unlock_nodes holding the key unlocks this door for the rest of the SAVE, after which counts_flag reports it open without the key. unlock_nodes is 'basement' alone and deliberately excludes the_foundation: the door stands at the FOOT of the elevator, so standing in the on-grid Foundation at the top is not standing in the room with the door -- riding down is, and that arrives at basement.
Basement -> The Foundation: elevator; keycard to SUMMON if the car is not already down. Deferred: elevator position not modelled. Passes (stub open).
Basement -> Reservoir North: pallet-jack puzzle. Under the sim's 'player solves every puzzle' doctrine this always passes.

Well -> Reservoir South: the Basement door in the drained Fountain's floor, not consumed. Owner ruling: being at a node in unlock_nodes holding the key unlocks it for the rest of the SAVE, after which counts_flag reports it open without the key. unlock_nodes is both sides of the doorway (the wiki unlocks a Basement door 'from either side'), and both are unmodelled nodes the pathfinder only ever routes THROUGH, so a pass-through is what stands the player at this door.

Well -> Reservoir South, ADDITIONAL to basement_key_well on the same edge: 'this passage is only traversible while the fountain water level is 0' (Well page), re-checked on every traversal, independent of the permanent Basement Key unlock -- not latched. The engine sets the 'fountain_water_0' flag in GateContext when Game.water_level('fountain') == 0.
Reservoir North -> Mine North AND Rotating Gear -> Underpass: owner simplification collapses mine-cart move and gear positioning into a single 'mine_south_visited' flag set on first Mine South visit.

Reservoir South <-> Safehouse: rowboat, Reservoir water level exactly 6 (two-way), re-checked on every traversal against the current (permanent) level -- not latched. The engine sets the 'rowboat_water_6' flag in GateContext when Game.water_level('reservoir') == 6.

Reservoir North <-> Reservoir South: the boat crosses the Reservoir side-to-side once the Reservoir water level has EVER been set to exactly 13 (docs/areas.md's Pump Room section) -- permanent once set, UNLIKE pump_water_lte8/rowboat_water_6 above, which stay live checks against the current level rather than latching. The engine sets the 'reservoir_water_13' flag in GateContext from GameState.reservoir_13_reached (OR'd with the carried GameConfig.reservoir_13_reached), set permanently by Game.set_pump_level the moment the Reservoir is recorded at 13.
Tomb -> Catacombs: seven-angel puzzle (wall permanently broken once solved), but the Tomb must be drafted that day. Gate: Tomb room drafted/entered today.
Catacombs -> Mine South: lower Draxus's scythe. ONE-WAY; no reverse edge. Shuts at day end. Under the sim's 'player solves every puzzle' doctrine this always passes.

Mine South <-> Precipice: one physical stairway, lowered by lighting all 8 candlesticks from INSIDE the mine (reached via the Catacombs/Tomb puzzle, the drained Fountain + Basement Key, or the lowered Reservoir crossing from the north -- never from the Precipice side). Before it is lit, neither direction passes; the Precipice is not a front door into the mine. Once lit the stairway stays down permanently and both directions open. The engine sets this flag from state.special.lit_targets (the "mine_south" ignition target, special_items.json) in game.py::_gate_ctx. Note: the Upgrade Disk sitting in Mine South is obtainable WITHOUT this; it is a separate, ungated pickup on arrival.
Precipice -> Unknown (Underground): Castling Puzzle. Under the sim's 'player solves every puzzle' doctrine this always passes.

Underpass -> Upper Rotating Gear: red door powered by Boiler Room steam. Owner decision (docs/areas.md's "graduated" section, 2026-08-06): the player unlocks this door permanently the first time they enter the Boiler Room -- no power/steam system modelling needed beyond that one flag. The engine sets this flag in game.py::_gate_ctx from state.boiler_room_steam (set on Boiler Room entry, game.py::_enter) OR the carried-over cfg.boiler_room_steam (shops.py::carryover, env/multiday.py::DayChain).
Underpass -> Inner Sanctum: mid-tunnel metal door (no key; resets daily). Under the sim's 'player solves every puzzle' doctrine this always passes.

Inner Sanctum -> Sigil Chambers: flavour-only walk-in gate (holding ANY unspent Sanctum Key). The real per-door unlock (consuming a specific key, opening one of the 8 realm doors permanently, granting its +2 allowance) is the Game.open_sigil_door(realm) action, not this edge -- see the sigil_chambers node's own notes.
Antechamber north door: sealed until the Inner Sanctum lever or Throne Room lever is pulled. The engine sets this flag in GateContext when the north-door segment is not DOOR_SEALED.

meta.notes: Unlatching from the inside is the act that sets west_gate_unlatched for the first time.
ONE-WAY; no reverse edge. Shuts at day end.
